title: 법원조사관 등 규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:01841:20030903:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Addendum <Supreme Court Rule No. 1841, September 3, 2003>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 (Transitional Measures)
Court investigation officers, family investigation officers, juvenile investigation officers, and domestic protection case investigation officers serving at the time these Rules enter into force shall be deemed to be court investigation officers, family investigation officers, juvenile investigation officers, and domestic protection case investigation officers, respectively, under these Rules.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Rules)
Article 15 of the Rules on Adjudication of Domestic Protection Cases shall be deleted.
